scenes.sub: Reduce price exposure deliberately, and know what each hedge costs.
scenes.vo: Reduce price exposure deliberately, and know what each hedge costs.

scenes.title: Key ideas
items: A hedge costs something (premium, funding, capped upside). Hedge the risk you can't…
scenes.vo: pays or earns funding; needs margin; the hedge ratio is your choice. Perp hedge: short a perpetual future against spot you hold. Cheap to open; Protective put: buy the right to sell at a strike. Costs a premium, and your loss is capped below the strike. Collar: buy a put and sell a call to pay for it. Cheaper protection in exchange for capped upside. A hedge costs something (premium, funding, capped upside). Hedge the risk you can't afford, not every risk.
scenes.cap: Perp hedge: short a perpetual future against spot you hold. Cheap to open; Protective put: buy the right to sell at a strike. Costs a premium, and your loss is capped below the strike. Collar: buy a put and sell a call to pay for it. Cheaper protection in exchange for capped upside. A hedge costs something (premium, funding, capped upside). Hedge the risk you can't afford, not every risk.

scenes.title: Worked example
scenes.vo: You hold 10 ETH at $3,000 ($30,000). 50% perp hedge (short 5 ETH): ETH falls 30% to spot minus $9,000, short +$4,500 to minus $4,500 (minus 15%) instead of minus 30%. Protective put: buy a 30-day $2,700 put for 2% ($60/ETH). Worst case per ETH = $300 drop to the strike + $60 premium = $360 (12%), however far ETH falls in that month.
scenes.cap: 50% perp hedge (short 5 ETH): ETH falls 30% → spot −$9,000, short +$4,500 → −$4,500 (−15%) instead of −30%. Protective put: buy a 30-day $2,700 put for 2% ($60/ETH). Worst case per ETH = $300 drop to the strike + $60 premium = $360 (12%), however far ETH falls in that month.

lines: What does a protective put cap?
scenes.sub: Answer: Your loss below the strike, for the option's term, at the cost of the premium.
scenes.vo: What does a protective put cap? ... Pause and think. ... The answer: Your loss below the strike, for the option's term, at the cost of the premium.
scenes.cap: What does a protective put cap? Pause and think. The answer: Your loss below the strike, for the option's term, at the cost of the premium.

lines: What does a collar trade away?
scenes.sub: Answer: Upside above the call strike, to pay for the put.
scenes.vo: What does a collar trade away? ... Pause and think. ... The answer: Upside above the call strike, to pay for the put.

lines: 20 ETH, 25% perp hedge, ETH −40%. Net loss if ETH was $3,000?
scenes.vo: 20 ETH, 25% perp hedge, ETH minus 40%. Net loss if ETH was $3,000? ... Pause and think. ... The answer: Spot minus $24,000, short +$6,000 to minus $18,000.
